message.content:
Below is a quick‑look guide to the most talked‑about **Crime‑Thriller** feature films that hit theaters or streaming platforms during 2020.  
(If you’re looking for something specific—like “best‑rated” versus “most popular”—just let me know!)

| # | Title & Year | Director(s) | Key Cast | Why It Stood Out |
|---|--------------|-------------|----------|------------------|
| 1 | **“The Little Things” (2020)** | *Dennis Lehane* | Denzel Washington, Rami Malek, Jared Leto | A gritty, atmospheric hunt for a serial killer in Los Angeles. Its tense pacing, strong performances, and twisty narrative earned it solid reviews and box‑office success even amid pandemic restrictions. |
| 2 | **“The Good Nurse” (2020)** | *Greta Gerwig* | Adam Driver, Olivia Colman, Paul Giamatti | Based on the chilling true story of nurse Charles Cullen who murdered dozens of patients. Gerwig’s direction turns a medical mystery into a taut courtroom thriller, while Driver delivers a chilling performance. |
| 3 | **“The Invisible Man” (2020)** | *Leigh Whannell* | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | Though marketed as a horror flick, its core revolves around stalking, manipulation, and forensic evidence—a modern take on classic noir tropes wrapped in a high‑tech thriller package. |
| 4 | **“The Hunt” (Sveriges Filmer, 2020)** | *Thomas Vinterberg* | Mads Mikkelsen, Lars Brygmann | A Danish–German co‑production where a man becomes the target of a nationwide hunt after being falsely accused of murder. The film blends social critique with relentless suspense, earning praise for its moral complexity. |
| 5 | **“The Midnight Hour” (2020)** *(also titled “Midnight”) | *David Seltzer* | Michael Biehn, John Travolta | An indie‑style crime thriller following two brothers caught up in a dangerous drug deal gone wrong. While less mainstream, it offers tight plotting and a raw look at loyalty under pressure. |

### Quick Tips If You Want More Depth

| What you’d like → | Suggested Action |
|--------------------|------------------|
| Highest‑Rated (Rotten Tomatoes / Metacritic) | Check “The Little Things,” “The Good Nurse.” Both sit above 70% on Rotten Tomatoes. |
| Most Popular Streaming Picks | “The Invisible Man” (Netflix) and “The Little Things” (Amazon Prime Video). |
| Award‑Nominated | “The Good Nurse” received several Emmy nods for its TV adaptation version. |
| Indie‑Focused | “The Midnight Hour” and “The Hunt” offer lower budgets but higher artistic risk. |

Feel free to dive deeper into any title—or tell me what kind of crime‑thriller vibe you prefer (e.g., police procedural vs. psychological cat‑and‑mouse)—so I can fine‑tune the list further!
